title: Vlad Ursu wins bronze at the 2024 European Championships in Linz
body_html:
For the Republic of Moldova, the day ended with a medal in the quarter-finals of the 2024 European Table Tennis Championships in Austria, thanks to Vladislav URSU’s convincing and commanding performance in the hall in Linz.

The Republic of Moldova is therefore guaranteed a bronze medal in the men’s doubles, after the Moldovan-Austrian pair Vladislav Ursu/Maciej KOLODZIEJCZYK beat Slovenia’s Peter Hribar/Deni Kozul 3-0 in today’s quarter-final.

Every table tennis fan in Moldova took enormous pleasure in the performance of our master and ATTP member, and in the confidence the Ursu/Kolodziejczyk pair showed in this important match.

Vladislav URSU has become the first — and so far the only — medallist for the Republic of Moldova at these European Championships, and the whole ATTP team sends him its warmest congratulations and best wishes!
